user_journeys.description: General website navigation and content discovery

proposed_scenarios.scenario_name: Discovered Workflow: navigation_flow - Homepage Load Verification
proposed_scenarios.description: A foundational smoke test to confirm the website's homepage is accessible. Due to a lack of captured user interactions, this is the only testable scenario that can be generated from the provided data. It validates the primary entry point of the site.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify that the website's main entry point (homepage) successfully loads and is available to users.
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a new visitor, I want to load the homepage successfully so that I can begin my shopping experience.

detailed_steps.description: Load the main website homepage at https://atid.store/.
detailed_steps.business_impact: First impression and site accessibility; if this fails, no other user journeys can begin.

expected_results: User successfully navigates to the homepage.
The page URL is verified to be 'https://atid.store/'.
The page loads without any critical errors.
edge_cases_to_test: Page load performance on slow network conditions.
How the page renders on different viewport sizes (desktop, tablet, mobile).
Handling of URL parameters or fragments on initial load.
prerequisites: The website 'https://atid.store/' is deployed and accessible.
A stable internet connection is available for the test runner.
